facts: Parties: Ivybridge Foods Ltd (Buyer), Pemberton Marine Ltd (Seller); the Company is Kingsmere Engineering Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 12 February 2026; Closing is scheduled for 23 March 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 120 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 12 February 2026), either party may terminate.
Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Eskdale Energy plc.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Corrib Engineering Ltd. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 27 July 2026.
